newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks close up on strong HLL, TISCO.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks close up on strong HLL, TISCO.

text.p: Strong buying in shares of soap-to-foods conglomerate Hindustan Lever Ltd and steel maker TISCO pushed Delhi share prices to a higher close on Wednesday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 5.58 points higher at 888.03 points.
"It seems buying interest has re-emerged now as players have started building fresh positions at lower prices," said Vishambhar Dutt of stockbrokers Portfolio Management.
Hindustan Lever rose 39.00 rupees to 1,419.00 on buying by foreign investors and short-covering by speculators, brokers said.
Brokers said the detention of Bihar chief minister Laloo Prasad Yadav by a special court failed to make an impact on the market.

Yadav, indicted in a $280-million dollar scandal, was detained on Wednesday for a week by a special court after the Supreme Court, India's highest court, rejected his appeal against a Bihar court's refusal to grant him "anticipatory bail" on Tuesday.
Traders said profit-taking pushed some stocks to a lower close. Reliance Industries closed 2.10 rupees lower at 356.00.
State Bank of India dropped 1.00 rupee to 316.35.
Larsen and Toubro slipped 1.50 rupee to 269.10.
